name: The Reach
source:
The Reach is a short story about two boys having to make a choice between following their passions or helping someone in need. 

[From [url=https://fielstoria.itch.io/the-reach]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《The Reach》是一篇短篇故事，讲述两个男孩必须在追求自己的热忱与帮助有需要的人之间作出选择。

[来源：[url=https://fielstoria.itch.io/the-reach]Itch.io[/url]]
